story: Emergency follow-up: user still saw mobile day/week tab overlap; hard-separate mobile schedule status/actions from top tabs and force SW cache refresh.
changes: Removed sticky positioning from mobile 일별/주간 view switch to prevent underlying text from sliding under it.
Removed top-of-week 수강중/미배정/배정 controls from immediately below 일별/주간.
Moved week-view 배정/미배정/수정/수강중 controls into a bottom fixed action rail above the mobile tab bar.
Kept day-view summary below the date header and moved 변동 배정 into the separated summary row.
Bumped service worker cache version so mobile browsers stop serving the earlier layout.
userAction: On a previously opened mobile browser, refresh once. If it still shows old layout, close the tab and reopen the app so the new service worker activates.
